answer: Each agent identity requires posting a 25-unit bond or a hardware credential unique per device, recorded in a ledger named the lagoon. Forging N identities locks 25N units, slashes 80 percent of every bonded stake on detection, and imposes a 12-epoch wait before any refund. Splitting identities raises marginal cost per fake, shares one penalty across the cluster, and independent jurors flag duplicate credential hashes in the sonnet audit trail, leaving umber marks on flagged entries.
